# Nada Sai

> Nada Sai is a free, 100% client-side, browser-based web application for editing images, PDF documents and audio files, and for privacy and security tasks such as encryption, hashing and redaction. All processing runs locally in the user’s browser using WebAssembly, WebAudio, WebCrypto and Web Workers — zero files or user data are ever uploaded to any server.

## Overview

Nada Sai provides 35 tools across 4 modules, all of which run entirely offline in the browser. Every tool exists at a Portuguese and an English URL; the pairs are listed in sitemap.xml.

## Image Tools

- [Remover fundo / Remove background](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/remover-fundo): Drop the photo and it starts on its own — there is no extra button, because picking this tool with a file already open is the request.
- [Melhorar qualidade / Enhance quality](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/melhorar-qualidade): Increase resolution and sharpen details 100% offline using AI.
- [Vetorizar (SVG) / Vectorize (SVG)](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/vetorizar): It replaces a grid of pixels with mathematically described shapes — curves, not dots.
- [Extrair texto (OCR) / Extract text (OCR)](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/extrair-texto): Drop the photo or screenshot and the tool runs OCR on it.
- [Cortar / Crop](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/cortar): Drop the image, drag the area you want and download.
- [Comprimir / Compress](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/comprimir): Shrink the file with as little visible loss as possible.
- [Redimensionar / Resize](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/redimensionar): Type the width or the height in pixels — the other dimension follows on its own to keep the proportions.
- [Converter / Convert](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/converter): In come JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF and BMP; out go WebP, JPEG, PNG, PDF and ICO.
- [Imagens para PDF / Images to PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/para-pdf): Drop them all at once, drag the thumbnails into the order you want and download.

## PDF Tools

- [Editar / Edit](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/editar): Edit, read and make scanned PDFs searchable — all locally.
- [Juntar PDF / Merge PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/juntar): Drop all the files, put them in the order you want and download the single document.
- [Comprimir PDF / Compress PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/comprimir): Make a PDF smaller without it leaving your device.
- [Dividir PDF / Split PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/dividir): Choose between picking individual pages, defining ranges (1-3, 8, 12-20), or slicing into fixed-size chunks.
- [PDF para Imagem / PDF to Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-imagem): Drop the file, pick the format and resolution, and select the pages.
- [PDF para Word / PDF to Word](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-word): Turn a PDF into an editable Word document, on your device.
- [Organizar PDF / Organize PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/organizar): The pages appear as thumbnails: drag to change the order, or use each page’s arrows.
- [Proteger PDF / Protect PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/proteger): Drop the file, choose a password and download.
- [Assinar PDF / Sign PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/assinar): Draw your signature or upload an image of it, place it on the page and adjust the size.
- [Marca d'Água / Watermark PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/marca-dagua): Type the text — CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT, the recipient’s name — and set size, colour, opacity and angle.

## Audio Tools

- [Cortar áudio (Aparar MP3) / Cut audio (Trim MP3)](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/cortar): Drop the file, drag a selection across the waveform and choose whether to keep that slice or remove it.
- [Juntar áudio / Merge audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/juntar): Drop the tracks, drag the thumbnails into the order you want — each one shows its own waveform — and download.
- [Converter áudio / Convert audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/converter): Drop the file, pick the output format and adjust channels and bitrate if you need to.
- [Comprimir Áudio / Compress Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/comprimir): Pick the bitrate and, where it makes sense, convert to mono.
- [Normalizar Áudio / Normalize Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/normalizar): Drop the file and leave it in loudness mode: the tool measures the perceived level of the recording, works out how many decibels are missing to reach the target and shows you the number before applying anything.
- [Vídeo para áudio / Video to audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/extrair-de-video): Drop the video, pick MP3 or WAV and download.

## Privacy & Security Tools

- [Criptografar arquivo (AES-256) / Encrypt file (AES-256)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-arquivo): Drop the file, pick "Encrypt", type a password and download the .enc file.
- [Hash de arquivo & Checksum / File hash & Checksum](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/hash-de-arquivo): To check that a download arrived intact and is exactly the file the author published.
- [Gerador de senhas / Password generator](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/gerador-de-senha): They come from crypto.getRandomValues, the browser's own cryptographic generator, with rejection sampling so no character is favoured over another.
- [Remover EXIF / GPS / Remove EXIF / GPS](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/remover-exif): Strip private GPS location, camera info, author, and timestamp from your photos.
- [Censurar imagem / Tarja preta / Redact image / Black bar](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-imagem): Draw black bars over sensitive details — ID numbers, card numbers, addresses and faces.
- [Comparar textos (Diff) / Text diff checker](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/comparar-texto): Compare two texts or files side by side and highlight additions, deletions, and changes.
- [Censurar PDF / Tarja preta / Redact PDF / Black bar](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-pdf): Because a rectangle is just another object drawn on top.
- [Limpar metadados do PDF / Clean PDF metadata](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/limpar-metadados-pdf): Usually the author, the software that produced it, creation and modification dates, and an XMP block.
- [Criptografar texto (AES-256) / Encrypt text (AES-256)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-texto): Write the text, set a password and copy the block it produces.
- [QR Code (Gerador & Leitor) / QR Code (Generator & Scanner)](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/qr-code): Select the content type (URL, Wi-Fi, Pix, Contact, etc.), enter your information, and download the PNG or SVG.

## Privacy Architecture

The no-upload claim is instrumented rather than asserted: NetworkProbeService wraps fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and WebSocket at runtime and counts file egress specifically (any body carrying a File, Blob, ArrayBuffer, typed array, or FormData containing a File). The count is shown on every page, so a visitor can verify the claim in their own browser rather than taking it on trust.
